content.title: KATSEYE's Manon Bannerman Talked About How Group Wasn't Always on the 'Same Page' Before Hiatus Announcement
content.text: Manon Bannerman; KATSEYE. Credit : Daria Kobayashi Ritch for NYLON NEED TO KNOW KATSEYE's Manon Bannerman spoke about how the group wasn't always on the "same page""You pick your battles," she said during a NYLON cover story interview published on Tuesday, April 7Bannerman announced her hiatus in February and removed KATSEYE from her Instagram bio earlier this month Manon Bannerman has opened up about KATSEYE's dynamics amid her ongoing hiatus from the group. In a cover story with NYLON published on Tuesday, April 7, the Switzerland-born musician spoke about how KATSEYE's band members — who currently include Yoonchae Jeung, Sophia Laforteza, Daniela Avanzini, Lara Raj and Megan Skiendiel — were not always on the "same page." “Being in a group, it’s just about good communication and setting good boundaries and building a friendship, but also work relationship, and always remembering that it’s a shared goal that we have,” Bannerman told the publication. At the time, she noted that because there are six members, "obviously not everyone’s always going to be on the same page about everything," she says, giving the example of two of the members wanting to wear the same outfit and deciding who can between them. “But I think we all are at, or have been learning and are finally coming to, a point where for the group’s sake, you give and you take," said Bannerman. "You pick your battles.” Per NYLON, KATSEYE declined to address Bannerman's hiatus or the fan commentary around it after the news broke. Related Stories Bannerman’s hiatus was initially announced on Feb. 20 in a statement shared on KATSEYE's official X account. “Hello. After open and thoughtful conversations together, we are sharing that Manon will be taking a temporary hiatus from group activities to focus on her health and wellbeing,” the statement read. It continued, “We fully support this decision. KATSEYE remains committed to showing up for one another and for the fans who mean everything to us. The group will continue scheduled activities during this time, and we look forward to being together again when the time is right.” KATSEYE. Daria Kobayashi Ritch for NYLON Earlier this month, Bannerman shared a message, reportedly posted to the fan platform Weverse, sharing her gratitude for fans' ongoing support during her time away from the band. “Thank you so much for all the love and support you've been sending my way,” she wrote at the time. “I'm really grateful for the patience and kindness everyone has shown during this time. HxG and I are having positive conversations and I feel supported. I'm happy and I'm healthy. I'll share more soon. Thank you for always being there for me.” Fans also noticed that around the same time Bannerman appeared to remove any reference to KATSEYE from her Instagram bio. KATSEYE is set to perform at Coachella this weekend in Indio, Calif. on Friday, April 10 and the following weekend on April 17. Whether Bannerman will participate in the shows or not remains unclear.
